purpose: Record why investigated public impact and facility sources were not promoted to numerical criteria or geolocated facility records

records.locator: Building vulnerability and ash loading discussion
records.finding: Vulnerability depends on roof design, span, slope, construction quality and ash wetness. General guidance does not assess the capacities or conditions of local roofs.
records.decision: No universal numerical roof capacity imported. A reviewed criterion must specify load threshold, receptor type and matching roof/ash conditions. Missing criteria or conditions remain unknown.

records.finding: The broad 100–150 mm severe-effect statement is not a measured threshold for a specified local crop, growth stage, ash chemistry or rainfall condition.
records.decision: No local crop damage threshold imported. Reporting cutoff remains 0.5 mm and is not a damage criterion.

records.locator: Dam Information and Dam Water Level Update
records.finding: Retrieved primary text identifies reservoirs and water-level monitoring, without explicit geolocated intake or treatment-facility records suitable for this inventory.
records.decision: Reservoir names and levels do not establish a reviewed facility coordinate. No coordinates inferred from a town centroid.

records.locator: Water Treatment; embedded map; operator facility descriptions
records.finding: Primary operator page lists named plants, process descriptions and an embedded map, but retrieved text does not expose geographic coordinate records or representative-point definitions.
records.decision: Did not substitute office address, corporate map marker or approximate town coordinate for a treatment plant.

records.finding: Direct authoritative page retrieval returned HTTP 403. Search result identifies a district directory, without reviewed facility coordinates.
records.decision: Directory not imported as a geolocated water-facility inventory.

records.publisher: DENR Environmental Management Bureau; MWSS project report
records.locator: Indexed Table 6-3.1, printed page 6-26; SW IPO 3 monitoring point
records.finding: Indexed primary snippet exposes coordinates for a surface-water monitoring point near Ipo tunnel intakes. Both direct PDF download and authoritative web open returned HTTP 403; original page, datum, context and point role could not be independently inspected.
records.decision: Retain as a candidate requiring source-context verification; no receptor added. A monitoring point must not be renamed a surveyed treatment-facility location.

remaining_limit: No water-facility receptor accepted. Any future screen would describe surface ash deposition only, not dissolved contamination, service interruption or water potability.
